transcript: Speaker A: दीदी, customer के questions का answer आप इतने confidently English में कैसे देती हो? [Sister, how do you answer customer questions so confidently in English?] Speaker B: पहले मैं भी चुप हो जाती थी। Customer किसी और staff से बात कर लेते थे। [Earlier, I also used to keep quiet. Customers would talk to some other staff.] Speaker A: फिर confidence कैसे आया? [Then how did the confidence come?] Speaker B: SpeakEasy app से। Vani AI के साथ daily practice की। [From SpeakEasy app. Practiced daily with Vani AI.] Speaker A: Vani AI क्या करती है? [What does Vani AI do?] Speaker B: हिंदी में समझाती है, English बुलवाती है और गलती तुरंत correct करती है। अगर pronunciation गलत हो, वो भी सुधार देती है, judge नहीं करती। [Explains in Hindi, makes you speak in English, and corrects mistakes immediately. If pronunciation is wrong, she corrects that too, without judging.] Speaker A: Time कितना लगता है? [How much time does it take?] Speaker B: रोज़ 15 minute. [15 minutes daily.] Speaker C: अभी SpeakEasy app download करें और फर्राटेदार English बोलना शुरू करें। [Download SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
